description: All 32 NFL teams grouped by conference and division. This is the canonical reference for prompt generation, schedule validation, and team lookups. Colors, cities, stadiums, and ESPN abbreviations are mirrored from assets/nfl-data.js NFL_TEAMS. Head coach, offensive coordinator, defensive coordinator, and QB1 fields are intentionally blank so they get filled from a cited source (team official site or ESPN team page) rather than from memory. Update these before Week 1 and re-verify after any mid-season change.

sources.personnel: TBD - fill from https://www.nfl.com/teams/ or each team's official site
